articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems today announced the launch of the second product in its High Voltage Power portfolio, the AHV85111, an isolated gate driver IC.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Expands Isolated Gate Driver Portfolio with Bipolar-Output Power-Thru IC

articles.summary: Allegro MicroSystems announced the launch of its new high-bandwidth current sensors, the ACS37030 and the ACS37032, which enable high-performance power conversion.
articles.title: Allegro MicroSystems Introduces High-Bandwidth Current Sensor Technologies Enabling High-Performance Power Conversion
